'''Meka Antos''' is a daughter of a [[Domani]] merchant house.

== History ==
Meka Antos is the youngest daughter of [[Yilvas Antos]], lord of a merchant house in [[Bandar Eban]]. Meka is fiery and sensual, and at sixteen, she was arranged to marry [[Lorwyn Kilvar]], the son of the ruling family of [[Ostin Falls]] on the border of [[Toman Head]] and [[Almoth Plain]]. She was eager to win respect for herself and her family by using the marriage to expand the family's sphere of influence. Unlike most Domani women, she does not consider the simplicity of Ostin Falls to be a punishment, but rather an opportunity to gain status. 

However, her potential husband did not approve of the marriage. Meka was not about to let a reluctant bridegroom stand in the way of good business, and ordered her guard contingent of a mounted captain and four armsmen to find Lorwyn and bring him back to Ostin Falls by either reason or force. Meka's guards eventually caught up to her bridegroom and had him returned to her.<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
